scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/mobile"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/backend
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/backend && npm run typecheck -w apps/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/backend
